settings.text:
Not sure which supplement is right for your dog? Have questions about ingredients, dosing, or results? Our knowledgeable pet wellness advisors are ready to provide personalized guidance to support your pet's unique health needs.

Whether you're concerned about your senior dog's mobility, looking to boost your pup's immune system, or seeking natural calming solutions, we'll help you find the perfect fit. We're available via email, phone, or chat to answer your questions and ensure you feel confident in every choice you make for your furry companion's wellbeing.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right supplement for my dog?
settings.row_content: Start by identifying your dog's primary wellness needs. Are they experiencing joint stiffness, digestive issues, anxiety, or skin problems? Each of our supplements targets specific health areas. Consider your dog's age, breed, size, and lifestyle. If you're unsure, our wellness team is happy to provide personalized recommendations based on your pet's unique needs.

settings.heading: How long does it take to see results?
settings.row_content: Results vary depending on the supplement and your dog's individual needs. Most pet parents notice improvements within 2-4 weeks of consistent use. Joint support and digestive health supplements may show benefits within 1-2 weeks, while skin and coat improvements typically appear after 4-6 weeks. For best results, we recommend giving supplements daily as directed for at least 30 days.

settings.heading: Are your supplements safe for all breeds and ages?
settings.row_content: Yes! Our supplements are formulated to be safe for dogs of all breeds and life stages, from puppies to seniors. However, dosing varies by weight, and some products are specifically designed for certain age groups (like our senior joint support formula). Always follow the recommended dosage on the product label, and consult your veterinarian if your dog has existing health conditions or is taking medications.
